description: Header file defining Vulkan debug report callback classes and functions, including callback management, message logging, and external Vulkan API function declarations.

classes.name: DebugReportCallbackList
classes.description: Manages a list of Vulkan debug report callback functions, allowing addition, removal, and message dispatch.

classes.name: DebugReportLogger
classes.description: Provides logging capabilities for Vulkan debug messages, supporting different message levels and object types.

methods.name: AddCallback
methods.description: Adds a new debug report callback to the list.

methods.name: RemoveCallback
methods.description: Removes a callback from the list.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Dispatches a debug message to all registered callbacks.

methods.name: PrintV
methods.description: Internal method to format and print a variadic debug message.
